## CodeRabbit review

Public repositories with fewer than 10 stars require a manual review request,
even when automatic reviews are enabled. Bot-authored PRs may also be skipped.

Once this PR is open and its changes are ready, comment `@coderabbitai review`
on the PR to request an incremental review. Use `@coderabbitai full review`
only when a complete new pass is needed. These commands are instructions for
an actual PR comment; text in this PR description does not trigger them.

- [ ] Request a CodeRabbit review on the final PR head.
- [ ] Verify that the review completed and covers that head; a walkthrough,
      summary, skipped notice or pending status alone is not review evidence.
- [ ] Address confirmed findings and record the review link and reviewed head
      SHA. If review cannot complete, record the reason for the maintainer.

If more commits are pushed after the review, request another incremental pass.
Do not treat CodeRabbit as a substitute for CI or the repository's required
human/independent review. Maintainers decide whether to merge if CodeRabbit
is unavailable.
